title: Anti-normalization mobilization reported across several Bahraini localities, 2 October 2020
location: Several localities reported by the February 14 Coalition and Islam Times, including Barbar, Northern Sahlah, Sitra, Saar, and Abu Quwah; national-vs-local organization unresolved.
organizer: Opposition groups called for Friday of the Fall of the Treasonous Agreement; February 14 Coalition report and Al Jazeera page mention Al-Wefaq and Amal as mobilization supporters.
threshold_50_evidence: None of the opened reports gives a size for any named gathering; simultaneous threshold of at least 50 is unsupported.

start_date.summary: Each opened report identifies 2 October 2020 as the action date.

location.summary: Reports name separate towns/localities; no evidence that one gathering occurred simultaneously in each.

demands.summary: Reports identify opposition to Bahrain’s normalization agreement and criticism of the Bahraini government/state policy.

participants.summary: No quantitative or threshold-sufficient participant evidence found in opened sources.

protester_violence.summary: Unknown; imagery and slogans do not establish violence.

notes: Searches point to a wider campaign beginning in September and continuing through October; not evidence of one continuous protest episode. Do not merge different locations/dates absent organization/episode evidence.
open_questions: Find contemporaneous independent participant-size evidence by individual location.
Check early October actions (1 and 8 October) and October 18-23 follow-ups for episode boundaries, onset, and distinct actions.
No exact start/end duration, consequences, violence, or state response established.

title: Protest against arrival of Israeli delegation, Manama, 19 October 2020
location: Manama; exact site unknown in opened article.
organizer: Unknown; Al-Wefaq images/social posts and Lualua material are cited by Anadolu.
threshold_50_evidence: Unresolved: “dozens” is not a clear >=50 finding and the cited demonstration video was not independently verified, according to the report.

start_date.summary: Anadolu dates the demonstration to Sunday, 19 October 2020.

location.summary: The report describes a street in Manama but does not name it.

demands.summary: The report links the protest to the arrival of the Israeli delegation and opposition to Bahrain-Israel agreements.

participants.summary: “Dozens” is imprecise and does not resolve the 50-person threshold.

occurrence.summary: Evidence is an Anadolu report based on opposition social media; the report says the video could not be independently verified.

notes: No separate independent corroboration. The posted video/image materials may overlap with sources discussed for the 2/23 October mobilizations; not treated as independent.
open_questions: Locate contemporaneous independent report or primary organizer documentation that verifies the actual gathering.
Resolve whether “dozens” supports the minimum threshold and identify exact location.
Check linkage to October 18 and 23 actions without merging automatically.

title: Anti-normalization demonstrations reported in Manama and villages, 23 October 2020
location: Manama and villages named by Press TV: al-Markh, Nuwaidrat, Sanabis, Bu Quwah, A’ali, Abu Saiba and Shakhura; per-site sizes and whether these were one coordinated action are unknown.
organizer: Unknown; article attributes one report to Arabic Lualua television and other claims to online footage.
participants_original: Press TV says hundreds across the country but only dozens in Manama; no per-gathering counts for named locations.
threshold_50_evidence: The countrywide aggregate cannot establish 50 simultaneous participants at any named gathering; the explicit Manama estimate is “dozens” and is unresolved.

start_date.summary: Press TV dates the actions to Friday, 23 October 2020.

location.summary: Several locality names are given, but the relationship and event organization are unclear.

demands.summary: Opposition is directed at Bahrain’s government normalization agreement and associated state policy.

participants.summary: A national aggregate is not a per-event count; Manama is characterized only as dozens.

state_response.summary: The article alleges security forces broke up protests in Abu Saiba and Shakhura; no independent check was sought and actual response details remain limited.

protester_violence.summary: Unknown; flag burning is not coded as violence against the state.

notes: Candidate remains granular and pending because the report lists multiple places but does not establish national coordination or a 50-person count at any one gathering.
open_questions: Find independently sourced per-location attendance evidence.
Assess reported dispersal from contemporaneous first-hand evidence.
Check neighboring-month continuity/onset before deciding episode ownership.
